inputs.xtext_rule_text:
FeatureChainMember returns SysML::Membership :
	  memberElement = [SysML::Feature | QualifiedName]
	| {SysML::OwningMembership} ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain 
;

decision: A qualified name or an owned feature chain member, as SysML 8.2.2.17.5 states it.
notes:
THIS IS THE SYSML VARIANT (ADR-0014). The other language states this production differently and is a separate unit, derived from its own clause and not consulted here. SysML writes the first alternative directly as `memberElement = [QualifiedName]`: a qualified name, resolved later to the element it names. The resolution is name resolution, not concrete syntax, so the rule carries the QualifiedName.

The two languages' bodies differ in factoring and, as far as their expansions go, accept the same text. That is recorded, not relied on: equivalence across languages is not something this unit asserts, which is why the production was split at all.

evidence.note: a QualifiedName cross-reference or an owned feature chain, matching this clause
